compiled_state.description:
# The issuelinks snapshot-enrichment merge is inline, so its guard test hand-mirrors it and will drift

## The problem

`fetcher.py:592-596` merges `client.get_issuelinks_map()` into the snapshot inline inside
`fetch_snapshot`. There is no named, directly-callable helper, so a unit test cannot exercise the real
merge without standing up a whole fetcher.

Change 1276 (bug `2b16-9be0-a8f5-41d9`) therefore had to reproduce it as `_enrich_like_fetcher`, a
byte-faithful HAND COPY that quotes the original. Its implementing agent flagged this itself as the
weakest link in the change, and it is right to be worried:

**What that copy guards is not cosmetic.** 2b16's guard **G1** decides whether an inbound link REMOVAL
may fire, by distinguishing "the peer was queried and has no links" (`"issuelinks"` key PRESENT, possibly
an empty list) from "we never observed this issue's links" (key ABSENT — enrichment failed, HTTP 410, a
fail-open partial map, or the issue fell outside a truncated page). If the production merge ever changes
so that key-presence stops meaning "observed", **G1 silently stops protecting and the removal path starts
deleting local deps from truncated reads** — while the hand copy keeps the test green.

This epic has already fixed THREE silent-truncation defects in this exact data path (change 1105;
`9263-b404-cb6c-463f`; `deac-4f5a-856a-49bd`, measured losing 92% of a snapshot). Turning those READ
bugs into a WRITE bug is the worst outcome available here, and a drifting test copy is precisely how it
would happen without anyone noticing.

## Note on scope

Bug `88d9-fe42-e50f-4067` carries an acceptance criterion to extract the sibling **parent** enrichment
merge for the same reason, so the pattern will already exist when this is picked up — this ticket is the
**issuelinks** half. Do them the same way.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] the issuelinks enrichment merge is a named, directly-callable helper, and `fetch_snapshot` calls it
      rather than inlining it — behaviour-preserving, pinned by a characterization assertion taken BEFORE
      the extraction
- [ ] 2b16's `_enrich_like_fetcher` hand copy is DELETED and its test drives the real helper
- [ ] a test asserts the property G1 depends on: an issue observed with zero links yields the
      `"issuelinks"` key PRESENT (empty list), and an issue the map never mentioned yields the key ABSENT
- [ ] mutation-checked: changing the merge so an unobserved issue gains an empty `issuelinks` list must
      turn a test RED, because that is the exact drift that would disarm G1
compiled_state.title: Extract the issuelinks snapshot-enrichment merge so 2b16's G1 guard test stops hand-mirroring it
